answer: In the glasshouse the furnace never cools, and the blower takes his gather from the same mouth every morning. Proof of glassblower bottle via gather weight record is the taking: a bottle the blower shapes only after 4 gathers are weighed, each gather taken from the same furnace. The ripple is the first gather, weighed at the furnace mouth; the wharf is the fourth, weighed when the bottle took shape. A cheat must weigh 17 false gathers and blow 17 false bottles, and the ledge still holds no glass of his making.
